title: Maximum Vacation Days
goal: Choose weekly cities to maximize vacation days starting from city zero.
strategy: Before each week, stay in the current city or take one direct flight. Keep only the best total for each ending city: every future choice depends on that city, so smaller totals at the same city can be discarded.

edgeCases: Rich unreachable cities cannot contribute vacation days
One city means staying every week
A two-flight chain cannot be completed in a single week
